calibration_contract.input: enabled role=load component power columns from energy_v2_components.csv
calibration_contract.power_basis: minute-mean voltage times minute-mean current proxy unless configured otherwise
calibration_contract.missing_policy: missing/non-finite/negative/outlier samples are excluded, never treated as zero
calibration_contract.outlier_policy: configured max_power_W is a documented screening limit; without it, a wide robust power-tail guard removes implausible telemetry spikes before state and model fitting
calibration_contract.band_policy: deterministic 1-D two-means for low/active; a log-power second split creates active/high only with >=0.2% source support, >=5 samples and >=14x median separation
calibration_contract.polynomial_policy: degree 1-3 candidate; episode-grouped holdout uses the same active-band p05-p95 runtime clipping as deployment; selection also requires >=10% RMSE improvement, monotonic support and endpoint error no more than 10% worse than the constant baseline
calibration_contract.off_policy: off defaults to 0 W; low/idle uses the observed low-power band when present
calibration_contract.shared_power_band_policy: configured paired feeds may borrow a missing high band from a sibling feed in the same physical unit; local high-band evidence always takes precedence
calibration_contract.date_split_policy: explicit whole dates may be excluded before fitting; excluded dates are never replaced or backfilled
